metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 8% a year over 5 years, 7% over 3 (steady); last 12 months -1%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 10% a year over 5 years, 10% over 3; last 12 months -43%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 105% of net profit (strong).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹614 cr, 0.02× equity; down from ₹1,056 cr in FY22.

bull.point: The company successfully exceeded its Q1FY26 U.S. revenue guidance of $220 million by delivering $226 million.
Management maintains a strong balance sheet with debt reduced to ₹614 crore, representing a low 0.02x equity ratio.
Operating cash flow remains robust, averaging 105% of net profit over the last five years.

bear.point: The FY26 EBITDA margin target was repeatedly lowered from an initial range of 23.5–24.5% down to 21%.
The launch of the Generic Advair product has been delayed from H2FY26 to Q4 of calendar year 2026.
Profit growth has significantly deteriorated, with a 43% decline in profit over the last 12 months.
